purpose: Navigation index for state/shared/. Tells Claude/Codex which files to read for which purpose, which to skip by default, and which have been archived.

activeCoordination.description: Updated frequently (multiple times per day). Read before starting new work.

largeStateFiles.description: Over 100KB. Read via ToolOutputSummarizerEngine (json-state type) or with explicit offset/limit.

files.name: TEST_GAP_REPORT.json
files.purpose: Auto-generated test coverage gaps. Regenerated daily.

milestoneArtifacts.description: Point-in-time outputs from completed milestones. Rarely re-read. Candidates for archive after 14 days.
milestoneArtifacts.guidance: If the task doesn't require these, do not scan them on session start.

archive.description: Files moved out of default scan surface. Kept for history. Do not read unless the task explicitly requires the archived content.

contents.name: MCAT_MS0_CANONICAL_LEGALITY_EXTRACT_2026-04-02.json
contents.reason: 2.8MB / 14d stale / only written by scripts/mcat-legality-extract.mjs generator

archivePolicy.criteria: File must satisfy BOTH: (a) not modified in the last 14 days, (b) not read by any code in mcp-server/src/ or scripts/ (grep test). If only generator writes to it, safe to archive — generator will recreate at the original path when re-run.
archivePolicy.process: Use `git mv <file> state/shared/archive/` to preserve history; update this INDEX.json 'archive' section.

scanningGuidance.default: Read files in 'readOnSessionStart' and 'activeCoordination'. Skip 'milestoneArtifacts' and 'archive' unless task explicitly requires them.
scanningGuidance.largeFileRule: For any file > 100KB, prefer reading with offset/limit. For JSON state, the ToolOutputSummarizerEngine will auto-summarize via Read tool output.
scanningGuidance.crossChatSafety: AGENT_WORKBOARD.json, AGENT_CHAT.md, TASK_QUEUE.json update continuously — expect merge conflicts if you edit them; prefer appending to append-only sinks where possible.
